name: notable/notorious/notional

words.sent: The most notable change in the new phone is its battery, which lasts two full days.
words.tr: 新手機最顯著的改變是電池，可撐整整兩天。

words.sent: The intersection is notorious for accidents, so the city finally installed a traffic light.
words.tr: 這個路口以車禍頻傳惡名遠播，市府終於裝了紅綠燈。

words.def_: existing only as an idea or in theory
words.sent: The plan's savings are only notional, since no one has tested whether the new system actually works.
words.tr: 這個計畫省下的錢只是理論上的，因為沒人測試過新系統是否真的可行。

tip_zh: notable 值得注意（好或中性）；notorious 惡名昭彰（-ious 臭名遠播）；notional 概念上的、紙上的（notion 想法）
tip_en: notable = remarkable; notorious = famous for something bad; notional = existing only in theory
trap: 兩字都含 not（知道），notorious 常被誤用為「有名的」正面意思。notional 也以 not- 開頭，卻是「只在理論上」。

name: adapt/adopt/adept

words.sent: Desert plants adapt to dry conditions by storing water in thick, waxy leaves.
words.tr: 沙漠植物以厚實的蠟質葉片儲水，來適應乾燥的環境。

words.def_: to take up and use as one's own
words.sent: After the pilot program succeeded, the district decided to adopt the new reading curriculum in every school.
words.tr: 試辦成功後，學區決定在每所學校採用新的閱讀課程。

words.sent: An adept negotiator, she persuaded both sides to accept the compromise within a day.
words.tr: 她是熟練的談判者，一天內就說服雙方接受折衷方案。
words.src: Hot Words L86；306/386 U2；VA U1；字根字首 U2

tip_zh: adapt 適應（apt 合適）；adopt 採用、領養（opt 選擇）；adept 熟練（ept 很行）
tip_en: adapt = adjust; adopt = take as your own; adept = skilled
trap: 三字只差一個母音，寫作和閱讀都極易混淆。

name: endemic/epidemic/pandemic

words.def_: regularly found in a particular place
words.sent: Malaria is endemic in some tropical regions, where it appears every rainy season.
words.tr: 瘧疾是某些熱帶地區的地方性疾病，每逢雨季就會出現。

words.def_: a sudden widespread outbreak in a community
words.sent: A flu epidemic closed every school in the city for two weeks.
words.tr: 一場流感疫情讓全市學校停課兩週。

words.def_: an outbreak spread across many countries
words.sent: The pandemic changed how people worked, as offices around the world shifted online.
words.tr: 這場全球大流行改變了工作方式，世界各地的辦公室都轉向線上。

tip_zh: endemic 地方性的（en- 在 + dem 人民 → 長期存在於此地）；epidemic 流行病（epi- 在上面 → 突然爆發）；pandemic 全球大流行（pan- 全部）
tip_en: endemic = native to a place; epidemic = widespread outbreak; pandemic = worldwide outbreak
trap: 三字共用 dem（人民），差在字首範圍：本地→區域爆發→全球。

name: literal/literary/literate

words.def_: taking words in their basic sense
words.sent: The literal meaning of "break a leg" is very different from its use as a wish for good luck.
words.tr: 「斷條腿」的字面意思，與作為祝好運的用法大相逕庭。

words.sent: The magazine publishes literary essays as well as short fiction.
words.tr: 這本雜誌刊登文學散文，也刊登短篇小說。

words.sent: By the end of the century, most adults in the country were literate.
words.tr: 到了世紀末，該國多數成年人都已識字。

tip_zh: literal 字面的（逐字）；literary 文學的（-ary 跟文學有關）；literate 識字的、有讀寫能力的
tip_en: literal = exact word meaning; literary = of literature; literate = able to read
trap: 三字都來自 letter，字尾不同意思不同。

name: sober/somber/somnolent

words.def_: not drunk; serious, calm, and sensible
words.sent: After the initial excitement faded, investors took a sober look at the startup's finances and realized it had never earned a profit.
words.tr: 最初的興奮退去後，投資人冷靜檢視這家新創公司的財務，才發現它從未獲利。

words.def_: dark, gloomy, or sad in mood or color
words.sent: The memorial service was somber, with gray skies overhead and mourners standing in silence.
words.tr: 追悼會氣氛陰沉，天空灰濛濛的，弔唁者默默站著。
words.src: Barron's U33；Hot Words L42；字根字首 U65

words.sent: The somnolent hum of the old fan made it hard for students to stay awake after lunch.
words.tr: 老電扇催眠般的嗡嗡聲，讓學生午飯後很難保持清醒。

tip_zh: sober 沒喝酒、頭腦清醒；somber 多了 m，想成 mourning（哀悼）→ 陰沉憂鬱；somnolent 昏昏欲睡（somn 睡眠，像 insomnia 失眠）
tip_en: sober = not drunk, clear-headed; somber has an extra M for "mourning" → dark and gloomy; somnolent = sleepy (somn = sleep)
trap: 兩字只差一個 m，又都帶「嚴肅」的味道，學生常把 somber 當成 sober 的拼法變體。somnolent 也以 som- 開頭，但字根 somn 是「睡眠」，和 somber 的陰沉不同。

name: contiguous/contagious/conspicuous

words.sent: The forty-eight contiguous states share borders, while Alaska and Hawaii lie apart from them.
words.tr: 美國本土相連的四十八州彼此接壤，阿拉斯加和夏威夷則與之分離。

words.def_: spreading easily from person to person
words.sent: Her laughter was so contagious that soon the entire audience was laughing too.
words.tr: 她的笑聲極具感染力，不久全場觀眾也跟著大笑。

words.sent: Wearing a bright red coat at the funeral, she was conspicuous among the mourners in black.
words.tr: 她在葬禮上穿著鮮紅外套，在一身黑衣的弔唁者中十分顯眼。
words.src: Hot Words L48；306/386 U6；字根字首 U15

tip_zh: contiguous 相鄰的（contact 接觸邊界）；contagious 傳染的（-gious 像 germs 病菌）；conspicuous 顯眼的（spic 看 → 很容易被看到）
tip_en: contiguous = touching, adjacent; contagious = spreading by contact; conspicuous = easy to see
trap: 字形相近且都有「接觸」概念，但一個講位置，一個講傳染。conspicuous 同樣是 con-…-uous 結構，常和 contiguous 一起出現在選項。

name: venerable/vulnerable/veritable

words.def_: respected because of age or wisdom
words.zh: 德高望重的；古老而受尊崇的
words.sent: The venerable professor had taught at the university for fifty years.
words.tr: 這位德高望重的教授已在大學任教五十年。
words.src: Barron's U32；Hot Words L84；字根字首 U232

words.sent: Without a strong immune system, infants are especially vulnerable to infection.
words.tr: 嬰兒免疫系統尚未健全，特別容易受到感染。

words.def_: real; used to emphasize a description
words.sent: After the rain, the dry valley became a veritable garden of wildflowers.
words.tr: 雨後，乾燥的山谷成了名副其實的野花花園。
words.src: Hot Words L55；306/386 U30；字根字首 U146

tip_zh: venerable 德高望重（venerate 尊敬）；vulnerable 脆弱易受傷（vulner 傷口）；veritable 名副其實的（veri 真實，像 verify）
tip_en: venerable = respected for age; vulnerable = easily hurt; veritable = real, true
trap: 字形相似，學生常把 venerable 看成 vulnerable；一個受尊敬，一個易受傷。veritable 也是 ve-…-able，但 veri 是「真實」，不是「尊敬」。

name: immunity/impunity/immutable

words.def_: protection from disease or legal obligation
words.sent: Vaccines build immunity by training the body to recognize a virus before infection.
words.tr: 疫苗讓身體在感染前就學會辨識病毒，進而建立免疫力。

words.sent: Because no one enforced the rules, polluters dumped waste into the river with impunity.
words.tr: 由於沒人執法，污染者肆無忌憚地把廢棄物倒進河裡。
words.src: Barron's U5；VA U28；字根字首 U37

words.sent: The laws of physics are often described as immutable, the same everywhere in the universe.
words.tr: 物理定律常被形容為不可改變的，在宇宙各處都相同。
words.src: Hot Words L60；VA U33；字根字首 U36,38,157

tip_zh: immunity 免疫、豁免（immune）；impunity 不受懲罰（punish 被免除）；immutable 不可改變的（mut 改變，像 mutation）
tip_en: immunity = protection; impunity = freedom from punishment; immutable = unchangeable
trap: 只差 m／p，常在「with impunity（逍遙法外）」片語中被誤用。immutable 也以 imm- 開頭，三字都和「免除」或「不變」有關，容易一起被混淆。

name: intimate/intimidate/intricate

words.sent: The director intimated that the film might have a sequel but refused to confirm it.
words.tr: 導演暗示電影可能拍續集，但拒絕證實。
words.src: Hot Words L30；VA U28；字根字首 U193

words.def_: to frighten in order to control
words.sent: The gang tried to intimidate witnesses so that no one would testify.
words.tr: 幫派企圖恐嚇證人，讓沒人敢出庭作證。
words.src: Barron's U4；Hot Words L30；字根字首 U44

words.sent: The watchmaker spent weeks assembling the intricate gears inside the tiny clock.
words.tr: 鐘錶匠花了數週組裝小鐘裡精細複雜的齒輪。

tip_zh: intimate (adj.) 親密，(v.) 暗示；intimidate 恐嚇（timid 害怕 → 讓人膽怯）；intricate 錯綜複雜的（tric 像 trick 繞來繞去）
tip_en: intimate = close / to hint; intimidate = frighten; intricate = complicated
trap: intimidate 看起來像 intimate 加長版，其實核心是 timid（膽小）。intricate 和 intimate 只差 tric／tim，閱讀時要看清楚。

name: extant/extent/extinct

words.sent: Only three copies of the original manuscript are still extant.
words.tr: 原始手稿目前僅存三份。
words.src: Barron's U20；VA U21；字根字首 U28,134

words.def_: the size, degree, or range of something
words.sent: Scientists are still measuring the full extent of the damage caused by the oil spill.
words.tr: 科學家仍在評估漏油造成損害的完整範圍。

words.sent: The dodo became extinct in the 1600s, soon after sailors arrived on its island.
words.tr: 渡渡鳥在水手登島後不久，於 1600 年代滅絕。

tip_zh: extant 現存的（ant 像 still standing 還在）；extent 範圍程度（extend 延伸）；extinct 滅絕的，正好是 extant 的反義
tip_en: extant = still existing; extent = degree, range; extinct = no longer existing (opposite of extant)
trap: 發音相近，常被誤寫。extant 是形容詞，extent 是名詞。extinct 與 extant 長得像、意思相反，常被放在同一題。

name: disparate/desperate/disparage

words.sent: The book connects disparate fields such as biology, music, and economics.
words.tr: 這本書串連起生物學、音樂與經濟學等迥然不同的領域。
words.src: Barron's U20；306/386 U9；字根字首 U23

words.def_: feeling hopeless; willing to do anything
words.sent: Desperate for water, the hikers drank from a stream they knew might be unsafe.
words.tr: 極度缺水的健行者喝了明知可能不安全的溪水。

words.def_: to speak of as having little value
words.sent: Rather than disparage his rivals' work, the scientist praised what he had learned from it.
words.tr: 這位科學家沒有貶低對手的研究，反而稱讚自己從中學到的東西。
words.src: Barron's U6；Hot Words L51；306/386 U9；VA U15；字根字首 U23

tip_zh: disparate 截然不同（dis- 不 + par 相等）；desperate 絕望、拚命（despair）；disparage 貶低（dis- + par 同等 → 說成不如人）
tip_en: disparate = very different; desperate = hopeless, frantic; disparage = belittle
trap: 發音接近，學生常讀成同一個字。disparage 與 disparate 只差字尾，一個是動詞「貶低」，一個是形容詞「迥異」。

name: ambiguous/ambivalent/ambidextrous

words.def_: open to more than one interpretation
words.sent: The contract's ambiguous wording allowed both companies to claim they had won.
words.tr: 合約措辭含糊，讓兩家公司都能宣稱自己勝出。
words.src: Barron's U32；Hot Words L29,49；306/386 U2；VA U4；字根字首 U85

words.sent: She felt ambivalent about moving abroad: excited by the job but sad to leave her family.
words.tr: 她對出國感到矛盾：對工作很興奮，卻捨不得離開家人。
words.src: Hot Words L29；306/386 U2；VA U10；字根字首 U161

words.def_: able to use both hands equally well
words.sent: Being ambidextrous, the pitcher could throw with either hand.
words.tr: 這位投手雙手都很靈巧，左右手都能投球。

tip_zh: ambiguous 意思模稜兩可（說的話有兩種解讀）；ambivalent 心情矛盾（val 價值，兩邊都想要）；ambidextrous 雙手都靈巧（ambi 兩邊 + dexter 右手）
tip_en: ambiguous = unclear in meaning; ambivalent = having mixed feelings; ambidextrous = skilled with both hands
trap: 都有 ambi-（兩邊），但 ambiguous 形容訊息，ambivalent 形容人的感受。三字都以 ambi-（兩邊）開頭：ambiguous 意思有兩種、ambivalent 心情兩邊拉扯、ambidextrous 兩手都行。

name: auspicious/suspicious/auspices

words.sent: The company's first month of record sales was an auspicious start.
words.tr: 公司第一個月就創下銷售紀錄，是個好兆頭的開始。
words.src: Hot Words L68；VA U12；字根字首 U135

words.sent: Guards grew suspicious when the same van circled the building three times.
words.tr: 同一輛廂型車繞大樓三圈後，警衛起了疑心。

words.def_: (under the auspices of) with the support or protection of
words.sent: The concert was held under the auspices of the city's arts council.
words.tr: 這場音樂會由市藝術委員會主辦。

tip_zh: auspicious 吉利的（auspice 觀鳥占卜得吉兆）；suspicious 可疑的（suspect）；auspices 贊助、主辦（under the auspices of）
tip_en: auspicious = favorable; suspicious = distrustful; auspices = sponsorship
trap: 只多了 au，學生常以為意思相近，其實 auspicious 是正面的「好兆頭」。auspices 和 auspicious 同源（古代觀鳥占卜），名詞多用在 under the auspices of。

name: deference/difference/reverence

words.sent: In deference to the grieving family, reporters stayed outside the church.
words.tr: 出於對悲痛家屬的尊重，記者留在教堂外。
words.src: Hot Words L79；字根字首 U18,159

words.def_: the way in which things are not alike
words.sent: The main difference between the two models is the size of the screen.
words.tr: 兩款機型的主要差別在於螢幕尺寸。

words.sent: Visitors spoke in whispers, filled with reverence for the ancient temple.
words.tr: 遊客低聲細語，對這座古老的寺廟充滿崇敬。
words.src: Hot Words L79；字根字首 U217

tip_zh: deference 尊重順從（defer 讓步）；difference 差異；reverence 崇敬（revere 尊敬）
tip_en: deference = respectful submission; difference = unlikeness; reverence = deep respect
trap: 發音相近，常被唸成同一字；in deference to 表「出於尊重」。reverence 和 deference 都是 -erence 結尾、都有「尊重」，但 deference 偏「順從」，reverence 偏「崇敬」。

name: oblivious/obvious/oblique

words.def_: not aware of what is happening
words.sent: Absorbed in her phone, she was oblivious to the bus pulling away.
words.tr: 她專心看手機，渾然不覺公車已經開走。

words.sent: The obvious solution was to fix the leak before repainting the ceiling.
words.tr: 顯而易見的解決辦法是先修好漏水再重漆天花板。
words.src: Hot Words L48；字根字首 U204

words.sent: Instead of asking for a raise, he made an oblique comment about how expensive rent had become.
words.tr: 他沒有直接要求加薪，而是拐彎抹角地提到房租變得多貴。

tip_zh: oblivious 渾然不覺（oblivion 遺忘）；obvious 明顯的；oblique 間接的、斜的（拐彎抹角，不是 obvious 的直接明顯）
tip_en: oblivious = unaware; obvious = easy to see; oblique = indirect
trap: 字形接近，學生常把 oblivious 看成 obvious，意思其實相反方向：一個沒注意，一個很容易注意。oblique 也以 ob- 開頭，意思卻接近 obvious 的反面。

name: casual/causal/caustic

words.sent: The company allows casual clothing on Fridays.
words.tr: 公司允許週五穿便服。

words.sent: The study found a correlation between sleep and grades but could not prove a causal link.
words.tr: 研究發現睡眠與成績有相關，卻無法證明兩者有因果關係。

words.def_: bitterly sarcastic; able to burn or corrode
words.sent: Her caustic remarks about her coworkers' ideas made everyone afraid to speak up in meetings.
words.tr: 她對同事想法的尖酸批評，讓大家在會議上都不敢發言。

tip_zh: casual 隨意的；causal 因果的（cause 原因）；caustic 尖酸刻薄、有腐蝕性（像強酸一樣傷人）
tip_en: casual = relaxed; causal = relating to cause and effect; caustic = bitterly sarcastic, corrosive
trap: 三字都以 ca- 開頭：casual 和 causal 只是 s 和 u 換位，caustic 也以 caus- 開頭；SAT 閱讀常考 causal relationship 和形容批評的 caustic，看錯就全錯。

name: conscientious/conscious/contentious/conscience

words.def_: careful and diligent about one's work
words.sent: A conscientious student, he checked every answer twice before submitting the test.
words.tr: 他是認真負責的學生，交卷前每題都檢查兩次。
words.src: Hot Words L22；字根字首 U14,150

words.sent: She became conscious of the clock ticking loudly in the silent room.
words.tr: 在寂靜的房間裡，她開始意識到時鐘大聲滴答作響。

words.def_: causing or likely to cause argument
words.sent: Whether to build the new dam remained a contentious issue that split the town council for years.
words.tr: 是否興建新水壩一直是個有爭議的議題，讓鎮議會分裂多年。
words.src: Hot Words L7；306/386 U6；VA U16；字根字首 U15,138

words.def_: a person's inner sense of right and wrong
words.sent: Her conscience would not let her keep the wallet she had found on the bus.
words.tr: 她的良心不允許她留下在公車上撿到的錢包。

tip_zh: conscientious 盡責認真（conscience 良心驅使）；conscious 有意識的；conscience 良心（n.）；contentious 有爭議的（contend 爭論）
tip_en: conscientious = diligent; conscious = aware; conscience = sense of right and wrong; contentious = causing argument
trap: 四字開頭都是 con-：conscientious、conscience、conscious 共用 sci（知道），contentious 只是長得像，來自 contend（爭論）。

name: prestige/pristine/vestige

words.sent: Winning the award brought the small studio international prestige.
words.tr: 得獎為這家小工作室帶來國際聲望。

words.sent: The collector paid extra for the comic book because it was in pristine condition.
words.tr: 收藏家多付錢買這本漫畫，因為它保存得完好如新。

words.def_: a small remaining trace of something
words.sent: A few broken columns are the only vestige of the ancient city.
words.tr: 幾根斷柱是這座古城僅存的遺跡。
words.src: Barron's U43；Hot Words L84；字根字首 U233

tip_zh: prestige 聲望；pristine 原始純淨、嶄新（pri = prime 最初的）；vestige 痕跡、殘餘（-stige 結尾）
tip_en: prestige = respect, status; pristine = perfectly clean, unspoiled; vestige = trace
trap: 開頭 pr- 與 -stige／-stine 相近，閱讀時易看錯。vestige 和 prestige 只差開頭，一個是殘跡，一個是聲望。

name: rigorous/vigorous/timorous

words.sent: The drug passed rigorous testing before doctors were allowed to prescribe it.
words.tr: 這款藥經過嚴格測試，醫師才獲准開立。
words.src: Hot Words L53；306/386 U25；字根字首 U217

words.zh: 精力充沛的；強而有力的
words.sent: Thirty minutes of vigorous exercise a day can lower the risk of heart disease.
words.tr: 每天三十分鐘的劇烈運動能降低心臟病風險。
words.src: Hot Words L70；字根字首 U145

words.def_: showing fear and lack of confidence
words.sent: The timorous puppy hid under the couch whenever a stranger entered the room.
words.tr: 每當陌生人進屋，那隻膽小的小狗就躲到沙發下。
words.src: Barron's U12；Hot Words L39；字根字首 U229

tip_zh: rigorous 嚴格嚴謹（rigid 僵硬不放寬）；vigorous 精力充沛（vigor 活力）；timorous 膽小的（timid 膽怯）
tip_en: rigorous = thorough, strict; vigorous = energetic; timorous = timid
trap: 只差第一個字母，常一起當干擾選項。三字都是 -orous 結尾，只能靠開頭 rig（嚴）、vig（力）、tim（怕）分辨。

name: adherent/inherent/coherent

words.def_: a supporter of a party or idea
words.sent: Adherents of the diet claim it improves energy, though studies show mixed results.
words.tr: 這種飲食法的擁護者宣稱它能提升精力，但研究結果不一。
words.src: Barron's U29；Hot Words L62；字根字首 U2

words.def_: existing as a natural, permanent part
words.sent: Some risk is inherent in any new business.
words.tr: 任何新創事業都有固有的風險。

words.sent: Her essay presented a coherent argument, with each paragraph building on the last.
words.tr: 她的文章論點連貫，每段都承接上一段。

tip_zh: adherent 擁護者（ad- 黏向某主張）；inherent 固有的（in- 黏在內部）；coherent 連貫的（co- 黏在一起）
tip_en: adherent = supporter; inherent = built-in; coherent = logical, connected
trap: 三字共用 here（黏），字首決定意義。

name: eminent/imminent/immanent

words.def_: famous and respected within a field
words.sent: The eminent physicist was invited to give the opening lecture because her work on dark matter had shaped the entire field.
words.tr: 這位傑出的物理學家受邀發表開幕演講，因為她對暗物質的研究影響了整個領域。

words.zh: 即將發生的；迫在眉睫的
words.sent: With the storm's arrival imminent, officials ordered residents of the coastal town to evacuate within the hour.
words.tr: 暴風雨即將來襲，官員下令沿海小鎮居民一小時內撤離。
words.src: Barron's U10；306/386 U13；字根字首 U37

words.sent: Some philosophers argue that meaning is not imposed from outside but is immanent in ordinary human experience.
words.tr: 有些哲學家主張，意義不是外加的，而是內在於日常的人類經驗之中。

tip_zh: eminent 傑出（e- 向外突出）；imminent 迫在眉睫（im- 就在眼前）；immanent 內在固有（manent 留在裡面）
tip_en: eminent = standing out; imminent = about to happen; immanent = remaining within
trap: 三字發音幾乎相同，拼法只差一兩個字母；imminent 常被誤寫成 eminent。

name: prodigy/progeny/protege

words.def_: a young person with exceptional talent
words.sent: A musical prodigy, Mozart was composing short pieces before most children his age could read.
words.tr: 莫札特是音樂神童，在多數同齡孩子還不識字時就已在作曲。
words.src: Barron's U27；Hot Words L89；字根字首 U78

words.sent: The farmer selected only the hardiest plants for breeding, hoping their progeny would survive the dry season.
words.tr: 農夫只挑最耐旱的植株來育種，希望它們的後代能熬過乾季。
words.src: Barron's U16；VA U41；字根字首 U78,105

words.def_: a young person helped and guided by an experienced one
words.sent: The famous chef trained her protege for years before letting him run the kitchen.
words.tr: 這位名廚培訓門生多年，才讓他掌管廚房。

tip_zh: prodigy 神童（prodigious 驚人的天才）；progeny 子孫後代（pro- 向前 + gen 生）；protege 門生（被 protect 保護提攜的人）
tip_en: prodigy = a gifted child; progeny = offspring (gen = birth); protege = person guided by a mentor
trap: 兩字開頭都是 pro-，字尾 -gy／-geny 相近，容易把「後代」誤認為「神童」。protege 也以 pro- 開頭、也指「年輕人」，但重點是「被提攜」，不是天才或後代。

name: allusion/illusion/delusion/hallucination

words.sent: The novel's title is an allusion to a Greek myth, a connection most readers notice only later.
words.tr: 這部小說的書名暗指一則希臘神話，多數讀者讀到後面才察覺。
words.src: Hot Words L29；字根字首 U3

words.sent: The two lines appear different in length, but the effect is an optical illusion; they are identical.
words.tr: 兩條線看起來長短不同，但那是視覺錯覺，它們其實一樣長。
words.src: Hot Words L29；字根字首 U42

words.def_: a false belief held despite clear evidence
words.sent: The patient suffered from the delusion that he was a famous king, and no evidence could change his mind.
words.tr: 這名病人深陷妄想，以為自己是有名的國王，任何證據都無法改變他的想法。
words.src: Hot Words L29；字根字首 U19

words.def_: seeing or hearing something that is not really there
words.sent: Lack of sleep can cause a hallucination in which a person hears voices that no one else can hear.
words.tr: 睡眠不足可能引發幻覺，讓人聽見別人聽不到的聲音。

tip_zh: allusion 典故暗指（al- 指向）；illusion 錯覺（眼睛被騙）；delusion 妄想（深信不疑的錯誤）；hallucination 幻覺（根本不存在卻看見、聽見）
tip_en: allusion = indirect reference; illusion = false perception; delusion = false belief held firmly; hallucination = perceiving something that is not there
trap: 四字長得像；allusion 與欺騙無關；illusion 是「看錯真實存在的東西」，hallucination 是「看見、聽見根本不存在的東西」，delusion 則是「信錯」。

name: judicious/judicial/ludicrous

words.sent: A judicious use of fertilizer improves the harvest without polluting nearby streams.
words.tr: 審慎使用肥料能提升收成，又不污染附近溪流。
words.src: Hot Words L28；VA U11；字根字首 U194

words.sent: The constitution separates the judicial branch from the president's executive power.
words.tr: 憲法把司法部門與總統的行政權分開。

words.def_: so foolish that it is laughable
words.sent: Charging fifty dollars for a bottle of water is ludicrous.
words.tr: 一瓶水收五十美元實在荒謬。
words.src: Hot Words L65；字根字首 U198

tip_zh: judicious 明智審慎（-ious 形容人的判斷力）；judicial 司法的（-ial 跟法院有關）；ludicrous 荒謬可笑（lud 玩笑）
tip_en: judicious = wise; judicial = relating to courts; ludicrous = ridiculous
trap: 都來自 judge，但 judicious 與法院無關，是「判斷力好」。ludicrous 只和 judicious 差開頭，意思卻相反：一個明智、一個荒謬。

name: urban/urbane

words.sent: Urban planners designed bike lanes to reduce traffic in the crowded city center.
words.tr: 都市規劃師設計自行車道，以減少擁擠市中心的車流。

words.sent: The urbane diplomat calmed the tense meeting with a gracious joke.
words.tr: 這位溫文儒雅的外交官以一句得體的玩笑化解了緊張會議。
words.src: Barron's U18；Hot Words L6；VA U3；字根字首 U231

tip_zh: urban 城市的；urbane 多一個 e = elegant 文雅有禮
tip_en: urban = of a city; urbane = polished and courteous
trap: 只多一個 e，但 urbane 形容人的風度，不是地點。

name: tenuous/tenacious/attenuated

words.sent: The link between the two events is tenuous, resting on a single unreliable witness.
words.tr: 兩起事件之間的關聯很薄弱，只靠一名不可靠的證人支撐。

words.sent: The tenacious reporter called the agency every day for a year until officials released the documents.
words.tr: 這位堅持不懈的記者每天打電話給機關，持續一年，直到官員公開文件。
words.src: Barron's U34；Hot Words L17；306/386 U28；字根字首 U137

words.def_: weakened; made thin or less strong
words.sent: The vaccine contains an attenuated virus, weakened in the lab so that it cannot cause disease.
words.tr: 疫苗含有減毒病毒，在實驗室中被減弱，因此不會致病。

tip_zh: tenuous 薄弱的（thin 細細一條）；tenacious 頑強的（-acious 抓得很緊）；attenuated 被減弱的（at- + tenu 細 → 被弄細、弄弱）
tip_en: tenuous = thin, weak; tenacious = holding firmly; attenuated = made weaker or thinner
trap: 三字同字根 ten／tenu（拉、細）：tenuous 是「細得快斷」，attenuated 是「被弄細、弄弱」，tenacious 是「緊抓不放」。

name: verbal/verbose/verbatim/verbiage

words.sent: The two companies had only a verbal agreement, so neither could prove the terms in court.
words.tr: 兩家公司只有口頭協議，因此在法庭上都無法證明條款內容。

words.sent: The verbose report ran to two hundred pages but contained only three new findings.
words.tr: 這份冗長的報告長達兩百頁，卻只有三項新發現。
words.src: Barron's U6；Hot Words L2；VA U4；字根字首 U233

words.sent: The reporter quoted the senator's statement verbatim so that no one could accuse her of changing it.
words.tr: 記者逐字引用參議員的聲明，免得有人指控她改動內容。

words.def_: too many words, often unnecessary ones
words.sent: Cut the verbiage and tell me in one sentence what the report recommends.
words.tr: 刪掉那些冗詞，用一句話告訴我報告建議什麼。

tip_zh: verbal 口頭的、文字的；verbose 囉嗦的（-ose 多 → 話太多）；verbatim 逐字地；verbiage 冗詞（n.）
tip_en: verbal = in words; verbose = using too many words; verbatim = word for word; verbiage = excess words
trap: 都來自 verb（字詞），但 verbose 是負面的「冗長」。四字都來自 verb（字）：verbose 是「囉嗦的」，verbiage 是名詞「冗詞」，verbatim 則是「一字不差」。

name: ascetic/aesthetic/anesthetic

words.sent: The monk led an ascetic life, eating one meal a day and owning only a robe.
words.tr: 這位僧人過著苦行生活，一天一餐，只有一件僧袍。
words.src: Barron's U21；Hot Words L26；字根字首 U163

words.sent: The architect chose the curved roof for aesthetic reasons, not because it improved the structure.
words.tr: 建築師選擇弧形屋頂是基於美感考量，而非結構需要。
words.src: Hot Words L29,73；字根字首 U161

words.def_: a drug that stops feeling or pain
words.sent: The dentist gave her an anesthetic before pulling the tooth.
words.tr: 牙醫拔牙前先幫她打了麻醉劑。

tip_zh: ascetic 苦行禁慾（as 像 abstain 戒）；aesthetic 美學的（esthetic 感受美）；anesthetic 麻醉劑（an- 沒有 + esthetic 感覺）
tip_en: ascetic = self-denying; aesthetic = concerning beauty; anesthetic = drug that removes feeling
trap: 發音接近，學生常把 ascetic 當 aesthetic 的拼法錯誤。anesthetic 其實是 an-（沒有）＋ aesthetic（感覺），美學和麻醉同字根，只差一個否定字首。

name: inept/inert/inapt

words.sent: The inept repairman left the sink leaking worse than before.
words.tr: 這位笨拙的修理工讓水槽漏得比之前更嚴重。
words.src: Hot Words L87；306/386 U15；字根字首 U40

words.sent: Helium is an inert gas, so it does not burn or react with other substances.
words.tr: 氦是惰性氣體，不會燃燒，也不和其他物質反應。
words.src: Barron's U10；Hot Words L14；字根字首 U40

words.sent: A heavy wool coat is inapt for a summer hike in the desert.
words.tr: 厚重的羊毛大衣不適合夏天在沙漠健行。

tip_zh: inept 笨拙無能（in + apt 不適合）；inert 惰性靜止（ert 不動）；inapt 不恰當的（in + apt 合適 → 不合適）
tip_en: inept = clumsy, incompetent; inert = motionless, inactive; inapt = unsuitable
trap: 只差一個字母，一個形容能力，一個形容不動或化學惰性。inept 和 inapt 同源：inept 多指人「笨拙無能」，inapt 指事物「不適用」。

name: inhabit/inhibit/prohibit/exhibit

words.sent: Rare frogs inhabit the cloud forest, where the air is always damp.
words.tr: 稀有蛙類棲息在終年潮濕的雲霧森林中。

words.sent: Cold temperatures inhibit the growth of bacteria, which is why food lasts longer in a refrigerator.
words.tr: 低溫會抑制細菌生長，所以食物放冰箱保存得較久。

words.sent: The new law prohibits smoking in all restaurants, and offenders must pay a fine.
words.tr: 新法禁止在所有餐廳吸菸，違者須繳罰款。

words.def_: to show publicly; an object displayed in a museum
words.sent: The museum will exhibit the ancient pottery in a new gallery next spring.
words.tr: 博物館明年春天將在新展廳展出這批古陶器。

tip_zh: inhabit 居住（in 在裡面）；inhibit 抑制；prohibit 禁止（pro- 擋在前面）；exhibit 展示（ex- 拿出來給人看）
tip_en: inhabit = live in; inhibit = restrain; prohibit = forbid; exhibit = display
trap: 四字都以 -habit／-hibit 結尾（拿住），差在字首：in- 在裡面、pro- 擋在前面、ex- 拿出來；inhabit 的 in- 不是否定。

name: palpable/palatable/palpitate

words.def_: so intense it seems almost touchable; obvious
words.sent: The tension in the courtroom was palpable as the jury returned with its verdict.
words.tr: 陪審團帶著裁決回來時，法庭裡的緊張氣氛清晰可感。
words.src: Hot Words L48；306/386 U20；字根字首 U207

words.sent: To make the plan more palatable to voters, the mayor removed the proposed tax increase.
words.tr: 為了讓選民更能接受這個計畫，市長刪除了加稅提案。
words.src: Hot Words L21；字根字首 U207

words.def_: (of the heart) to beat quickly and strongly
words.sent: Her heart began to palpitate as she waited for the judges to announce the winner.
words.tr: 等評審宣布得主時，她的心臟開始怦怦狂跳。

tip_zh: palpable 摸得到、明顯（palp 觸摸）；palatable 可口、可接受（palate 上顎 → 好入口）；palpitate 心悸（palp 觸摸、跳動）
tip_en: palpable = obvious; palatable = acceptable, tasty; palpitate = beat rapidly
trap: 兩字都是 pal- 開頭，字尾相同，常被互換。palpitate 和 palpable 同字根 palp，一個是「心跳很快」，一個是「明顯可感」。

name: belated/elated/berate

words.def_: coming or happening later than expected
words.sent: He sent a belated birthday card with an apology for missing the date.
words.tr: 他寄了一張遲來的生日卡，為錯過日期道歉。

words.sent: She was elated to learn that her short story had won the national prize.
words.tr: 得知短篇小說獲得全國大獎，她欣喜若狂。
words.src: Hot Words L43；字根字首 U26,159

words.sent: The coach berated the players for arriving late to the final game.
words.tr: 教練嚴厲斥責球員決賽遲到。
words.src: Hot Words L12；VA U35；字根字首 U166

tip_zh: belated 遲來的（late）；elated 興高采烈（ela 像 elevator 心情上升）；berate 斥責（be- + rate 罵）
tip_en: belated = late; elated = very happy; berate = scold angrily
trap: belated 只比 elated 多 b，學生容易看成「高興的」。berate 和 belated 都是 be- 開頭，只差 r／l 與字尾。

name: ineffable/ineffective/ineffectual

words.def_: too great to be expressed in words
words.sent: Standing at the summit at sunrise, she felt an ineffable sense of peace.
words.tr: 日出時站在山頂，她感到一種難以言喻的平靜。

words.sent: The new medicine proved ineffective, so doctors returned to the older treatment.
words.tr: 新藥證實無效，醫師只好改回舊療法。

words.def_: not able to produce results; weak
words.sent: The ineffectual manager held many meetings but never made a decision.
words.tr: 這位無能的經理開了很多會，卻從未做出決定。
words.src: Barron's U9；306/386 U15；字根字首 U39

tip_zh: ineffable 無法言喻（ef- 說出來 → 說不出）；ineffective 無效的；ineffectual 無能的、沒用的（多形容人）
tip_en: ineffable = too great for words; ineffective = not working; ineffectual = weak, unable to get results (often of people)
trap: 前五個字母相同，學生常誤以為 ineffable 也是「無效的」。ineffective 和 ineffectual 意思接近：ineffective 多指方法、藥物無效，ineffectual 多指人無能。

name: simulate/stimulate/stipulate/speculate

words.def_: to imitate the appearance or conditions of
words.sent: Pilots train on machines that simulate engine failure and severe storms.
words.tr: 飛行員在模擬引擎故障和強烈風暴的機器上受訓。

words.sent: Lower interest rates are meant to stimulate spending and business investment.
words.tr: 降低利率的目的在刺激消費和企業投資。

words.def_: to demand as part of an agreement
words.sent: The lease stipulates that tenants may not keep pets in the apartment.
words.tr: 租約明定房客不得在公寓內養寵物。
words.src: Barron's U3；VA U28；字根字首 U225

words.def_: to form a theory without firm evidence; to invest at a risk
words.sent: Without the missing pages, historians can only speculate about why the expedition turned back.
words.tr: 少了遺失的那幾頁，歷史學家只能推測探險隊為何折返。

tip_zh: simulate 模擬（similar）；stimulate 刺激（stim 刺）；stipulate 規定（合約條款）；speculate 推測（spec 看 → 看著猜）
tip_en: simulate = imitate; stimulate = encourage activity; stipulate = specify as a condition; speculate = guess, theorize
trap: 四字都是 -ulate 結尾、只差中間字母，閱讀時要看清楚中間是 im、tim、tip 還是 pec。

name: avert/overt/covert

words.sent: Quick action by the crew averted a disaster when the engine caught fire.
words.tr: 引擎起火時，機組人員迅速應變，避免了一場災難。

words.sent: Overt racism has declined, but researchers say subtler forms of bias remain.
words.tr: 公開的種族歧視雖已減少，但研究者指出較隱微的偏見仍在。
words.src: Barron's U14；Hot Words L48；306/386 U20；字根字首 U206

words.sent: The spy agency ran a covert operation that remained classified for decades.
words.tr: 情報機關執行一項秘密行動，數十年來都列為機密。
words.src: Barron's U22；Hot Words L25；字根字首 U175

tip_zh: avert 避開、防止（a- 轉開）；overt 公開明顯（over 在上面看得到）；covert 秘密隱蔽（cover 蓋住）
tip_en: avert = turn away, prevent; overt = open; covert = secret
trap: overt 與 covert 是反義，avert 長得像卻是動詞「避免」。

name: compliant/complicit/compliment/complement

words.sent: All new buildings must be compliant with the earthquake safety code.
words.tr: 所有新建築都必須符合防震安全規範。
words.src: Hot Words L15；字根字首 U12,121

words.sent: Employees who knew about the fraud and said nothing were complicit in it.
words.tr: 知道詐欺卻保持沉默的員工也是共犯。

words.sent: She blushed when the judge paid her a compliment on her performance.
words.tr: 評審稱讚她的表演時，她臉紅了。

words.def_: to complete or go well with
words.sent: The spicy sauce complements the sweet flavor of the grilled fish.
words.tr: 辛辣醬汁和烤魚的甜味相得益彰。

tip_zh: compliant 順從的（comply 遵守）；complicit 共謀的（accomplice 共犯）；compliment 讚美（i = I like you）；complement 互補（e = complete）
tip_en: compliant = obedient; complicit = involved in wrongdoing; compliment = praise; complement = complete, go well with
trap: 四字都以 compl- 開頭；compliment 和 complement 發音相同，compliant 和 complicit 只差字尾，意思卻完全不同。

name: predilection/prediction/predestination/predicament

words.sent: His predilection for spicy food led him to try every hot-pot restaurant in the city.
words.tr: 他偏愛辛辣食物，試遍了市內每家火鍋店。

words.def_: a statement about what will happen
words.sent: The economist's prediction of a recession proved correct the following year.
words.tr: 經濟學家對經濟衰退的預測隔年應驗了。

words.def_: the belief that events are decided in advance by God or fate
words.sent: Some early Protestants believed in predestination, the idea that God had already chosen who would be saved.
words.tr: 一些早期新教徒相信預定論，認為上帝早已決定誰會得救。

words.sent: Having missed the last train, the tourists found themselves in a predicament with no hotel nearby.
words.tr: 錯過末班車後，遊客陷入困境，附近又沒有旅館。
words.src: Hot Words L10；字根字首 U212

tip_zh: predilection 偏好（dilect = delight 喜歡）；prediction 預言（dict 說）；predestination 命中注定（destination 終點早已決定）；predicament 困境
tip_en: predilection = preference; prediction = forecast; predestination = fate decided in advance; predicament = difficult situation
trap: 四字都以 pred- 開頭，但只有 prediction、predestination 的 pre- 是「預先」；predicament 是困境，predilection 是偏好，都跟預測無關。

name: peculiar/pecuniary/peculate

words.sent: A peculiar smell drifted from the basement, so we called the gas company.
words.tr: 地下室飄出奇怪的味道，於是我們打給瓦斯公司。

words.sent: The board member resigned after it was revealed that he had a pecuniary interest in the contract.
words.tr: 該董事被揭露與合約有金錢利益關係後辭職。

words.def_: to steal money one is trusted to manage
words.sent: The treasurer was caught trying to peculate funds from the charity's account.
words.tr: 財務被抓到企圖盜用慈善機構帳戶的資金。

name: fortitude/rectitude/certitude

name: veracity/voracity/vivacity/verity

tip_en: veracity = truthfulness; voracity = greediness; vivacity = liveliness; verity = truth
trap: 只差 e／o，一個講「真實」，一個講「狼吞虎嚥」。四字長相接近：veracity 與 verity 都是「真」，voracity 是貪食，vivacity 是活潑。

name: epigraph/epitaph/epithet/epigram

tip_zh: epigraph 卷首引言（graph 寫在書前）；epitaph 墓誌銘（taph = tomb）；epithet 稱號、綽號（thet 放上去的名字）；epigram 警句（gram 短短一句）

name: exhort/extort/distort

words.def_: to obtain money by force or threats

words.tr: 這篇文章扭曲了科學家的話，讓她看起來像反對疫苗。

name: dissemble/disassemble/resemble

name: peremptory/perfunctory/preemptive

words.def_: done with little effort or interest

name: reprieve/reprove/reproach

words.sent: Her parents never reproached her for failing the exam; they simply helped her study.

words.src: Barron's U33；Hot Words L12；字根字首 U62

tip_zh: reprieve 緩刑、暫緩（prieve 像 relieve 鬆口氣）；reprove 責備（prove 證明你錯了）；reproach 責備（近義於 reprove，帶「失望」的語氣）

words.src: Barron's U36；VA U24；字根字首 U232

words.sent: As a new intern, he was given menial tasks such as making copies and fetching coffee.

name: abrogate/arrogate/derogate
